title: Harness context contract
description: The replay and correlation context carried by every function report. Every invocation is session-bound; report context identifies the harness function plus the session and workflow-instance correlation needed to replay the invocation and join back to the session start. Session origin is recorded by start-session and recovered through sessionId when needed.

sessionId.description: The session identifier observed or minted by the surrounding mechanism, normalized to a safe slug before it reaches the harness — the id becomes a log filename, so a raw host id is a path-traversal vector the contract rejects.

parentSessionId.description: The parent session identifier when this session was opened by another session; null for top-level sessions. Same safe-slug form as sessionId.

function.description: The harness function that produced this report.

sessionId.description: The session this invocation ran in.

parentSessionId.description: The parent session that opened this session, if any.

workflowInstanceId.description: The workflow instance this invocation belongs to, if any. Always prefixed by its workflowSlug followed by an uppercase Crockford-base32 mint of at least four characters (e.g. verification-01J9XQ) — the prefix is load-bearing: function 3's latest-open-instance deduction filters candidate entries by it.
